command:
set -euo pipefail
for f in apps/api/src/main/resources/db/migration/V*.sql; do
  echo "== $f"
  docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.test.yml exec -T -e MYSQL_PWD="${RICCON_DB_PASSWORD:-riccon_test_only}" mysql mysql --user=riccon --database=riccon --batch --show-warnings < "$f"
done
echo "V1-V7 applied as riccon, no ERROR 1419"
note: 非 SUPER 的 riccon 用户按 V1–V7 顺序重放迁移；binlog 开启且无 ERROR 1419
